inputs.now_ms: uint32 monotonic milliseconds; wrap is deliberate in one scenario
inputs.experiment_active: bool; chooses snapshot or legacy storage
inputs.snapshot/legacy.min_{heat,fan,vent,fog}_: eight wire-valid durations; selected 60, unselected 120 seconds
inputs.relay_out.fog: bool; upstream controller request used by actual exemption helper
inputs.willFog: bool; request entering the extracted safety and fog consumer
inputs.willVent: bool; desired vent before actual relay application
inputs.vent_rly.state/fog_rly.state: bool; actual pre-apply storage readback, never same-row telemetry output
inputs.RelayMeta[4,5]: persistent last_on_ms,last_off_ms,on_stamp_ms,runtime_ms; initialized once per process and advanced by actual relay code
inputs.manual_fog_force/fan_requires_vent: bool; upstream authority decisions, not reconstructed here
inputs.leak_block/occupancy_moisture_block/irri: six explicit bool upstream safety decisions

scope: synthetic single-consumer scenarios; upstream inputs explicit; actual helper and relay code
